title: Image Captioning App
description: DA3408 A4. Some PromQL was generated with Claude, prompt: "PromQL for Grafana panels of a Streamlit BLIP captioning app instrumented with prometheus_client (counters, gauges, histograms, summaries with mode/client_ip/session_id labels) plus node_exporter CPU/RAM/disk/network". Query logic is explained in GUIDE.md.

panels.title: App
panels.description: Is Prometheus able to scrape the app's /metrics endpoint (up metric).

panels.title: Node exporter
panels.description: Is node_exporter being scraped (up metric).

panels.title: Model loaded
panels.description: caption_model_loaded gauge, 1 once BLIP is in memory.

panels.title: App state
panels.description: Current value of the caption_app_state enum.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the app process started.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Images captioned per second (rate over 30s) by mode. Linear scale.

panels.title: Requests per minute
panels.description: Requests per minute by status (one image or one zip = one request). Linear scale.

panels.title: Inference latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Percentiles from the caption_inference_latency_seconds histogram, 1m window. Log scale.

panels.title: Average request duration
panels.description: Summary _sum / _count. A bulk request covers the whole zip, so it is much longer than a single one. Log scale.

panels.title: Errors and skipped files
panels.description: Errors by exception type and files skipped inside zips, per minute. Linear scale.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Failed requests / all requests over 5m (recording rule caption:error_ratio:rate5m). Linear scale.

panels.title: Images processed
panels.description: Total images captioned since the app started, by mode.

panels.title: Zip jobs
panels.description: Number of bulk jobs (caption_bulk_job_images_count).

panels.title: Images / zip
panels.description: caption_bulk_job_images _sum / _count.

panels.title: In progress
panels.description: Requests being processed right now (caption_active_requests).

panels.title: Sessions (5m)
panels.description: Browser sessions seen in the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Avg image size
panels.description: Average uploaded image size over 5m (histogram _sum / _count).

panels.title: Bulk queue
panels.description: Images still waiting in the running zip job, per session. Counts down as the job progresses. Linear scale.

panels.title: Upload rate
panels.description: Bytes received per second by mode. Linear scale.

panels.title: Images by client
panels.description: caption_images_processed_total grouped by the client_ip, session_id and browser labels.

panels.title: Activity per session
panels.description: Images per second by client IP and session (idle sessions hidden). Linear scale.

panels.title: CPU usage vs throughput
panels.description: Node CPU busy % (left) against app images/sec (right). Bulk uploads drive the CPU up. Linear scales.

panels.title: App CPU vs total CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used by the app process compared to the whole machine. Linear scale.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: App resident memory and model weights vs memory used on the machine. Linear scale.

panels.title: CPU / RAM / Disk usage
panels.description: Utilisation % from the node recording rules in rules.yml. Linear scale.

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: Bytes read and written per second, physical disks only. Linear scale.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Bytes received and sent per second (docker interfaces excluded). Linear scale.
